features: Superfast USB 3.0 Interface with UASP Support: The PowerShell S3 features USB 3.0 connectivity, delivering blazing-fast data transfer speeds up to 5Gbps. With UASP acceleration protocol, it ensures reduced latency and increased performance during large file transfers.

Compact 2.5-Inch SATA Drive with 500GB Capacity: Equipped with a 2.5-inch SATA HDD (supports up to 6TB, 9.5mm thick), the drive offers 500GB of secure storage for daily backups, movies, documents, and games in an ultra-portable form.

Tool-Free Installation & Wide Compatibility: Enjoy hassle-free setup with plug-and-play installation—no tools or drivers required. Fully compatible with Windows, macOS, Linux, and ideal for tablets, laptops, desktops, and mobile devices.

Built-In LED Indicator & Shockproof Design: An integrated LED flashes during read/write activity for status visibility, while the cushioned sponge layer inside the enclosure protects your hard disk against shocks and physical damage.

Reliable Chipset for Stable Performance: Powered by advanced chipsets (JMS578 and RTL9201R), this external HDD ensures high-speed connectivity, stable data transmission, and long-term durability for all-day computing needs.

High-Speed USB 3.0 with UASP Acceleration: Enjoy blazing-fast data transfers up to 5Gbps with the latest USB 3.0 interface, enhanced by UASP (USB Attached SCSI Protocol) support for significantly improved file transfer performance, reduced CPU load, and lower latency.

Spacious 1TB Portable Storage: This 2.5-inch external hard drive provides 1TB of ample storage—perfect for backing up important documents, high-resolution media, software libraries, or game data in a compact and travel-ready design.

Tool-Free, Plug & Play Compatibility: No tools or drivers required—just plug it in and go. Compatible with Windows, macOS, and Linux, and works effortlessly with desktops, laptops, tablets, mobile phones, and gaming consoles.

Shockproof Design with Activity LED Indicator: Built-in shock-absorbing sponge layer protects the drive from impact damage, while the LED indicator flashes to show read/write activity, giving you both durability and operational feedback.

High-Performance Chipset Architecture: Integrated with JMS578 and RTL9201R chipsets, the PowerShell S3 ensures consistent, fast, and reliable data transfers while maintaining power efficiency and system stability.
